verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a GenAI DDQ feature with "Autofill Automation for Questionnaires" and a library you can fill by uploading previous questionnaires, so AI-driven questionnaire answering from a knowledge source is a first-party capability. However, the evidence consists only of article and section titles, with no detail on how answers are generated or reviewed. Missing for 10: evidence that answers are grounded in the customer's actual controls/policies, a documented draft-review/approval workflow, detail on accuracy and depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill
